doc: FBL 0.12, section 4.9, FR-023: etalii.adp.ide.standalone/src/diagrams/wardley-map/backend/EtAlii.Adp.Diagram.WardleyMap.Tests/Fixtures/pipelines-both-forms.owm at ad1a4680a, unchanged. The pipeline of Kettle has its { on the line below it and owns that block, so its two components are its children; the legacy pipeline of Power, two numbers on its line, is read and opens nothing; Water's pipeline has an empty block. The body is opened alone, without a registration, so no id is stored and each element has the one DISL makes, which the fixture names but the reading does not compare.

steps.doc: A pipeline added for Customer is written with its brace on its own line, as the tool writes one: one insert-entry at the end of the document.
The undo removes all of it, the brace's two lines included.
A component added to Water's pipeline, whose block is empty, goes inside it, indented one step: the block's { on the line below the statement opens it.
The undo removes the component's line.
